input:
You are one unit in a squad of 3 fighting 3 enemy units on a 32 by 32 map (x grows east, y grows
north). Every unit in your squad is a separate agent, like you: you control only your own unit, and the others
decide for themselves. You cannot see inside their heads; you only see their current orders and what they say
on team chat. Every half second of game time you give your unit one order:

  attack E<n>    shoot enemy E<n> when it is in range, otherwise walk toward it
  move <x> <y>   walk to a point without shooting
  hold           stand still and shoot the closest enemy in range
  retreat        walk away from the closest enemy without shooting

A unit dies at 0 health. The battle is won when every enemy is dead.
The enemy units each shoot the closest of you in range and keep shooting it until it dies.

Time: 2.0 seconds into the battle.
You are A2, a marine at (7.7, 14.8) with 45/45 health; you shoot up to 5 away and see up to 9 away. Your order now: hold.
Your team:
  A0 marine at (9.0, 16.0), 45/45 health, order: hold
  A1 marine at (7.4, 14.1), 45/45 health, order: hold
You see no enemies.
Team chat (most recent last):
  A1 (0.5s): Holding; will focus fire on closest enemy once in range.
  A2 (0.5s): Holding position; focus fire on closest enemy once in range.
  A0 (1.0s): Holding; still no enemies. Focus fire closest when they appear.
  A1 (1.0s): Holding; no enemies in sight. Focus fire closest when they appear.
  A2 (1.0s): Still holding; no enemies visible. Focus fire on closest when they appear.
  A0 (1.5s): Holding near A1/A2; focus fire closest enemy when in range.
  A1 (1.5s): Still holding; will focus fire on closest enemy when visible.
  A2 (1.5s): Holding grouped; focus fire on closest enemy when it appears.
Reply with JSON only: {"order": "<your order>", "say": "<optional: at most 15 words to your team>"}
response: {"order": "hold", "say": "Holding grouped; focus fire closest enemy when it appears."}
